_comment: Front and back matter audited page by page on 2026-08-01. Unlike Brihat Jataka, this edition carries no covers, no advertisements for other titles and no promotional blurbs in its text layer. p0001 is the title page, p0002-p0003 the translator's preface, p0004-p0009 the table of contents, and p0265 the concluding chapter -- all genuine parts of the work and all retained. Nothing is excluded from this book.
